name: AVALAND
recent: Avaland 在2026年11月18日公布截至2026年9月30日止季度业绩，净利大幅增长至2993万令吉，为2024年第四季以来最高季度净利。公司近期以8604万令吉收购吉隆坡三块相邻永久地契发展地，并推出新项目 Accent Petaling Jaya，首推取得60%认购率。此外，公司为 Cybersouth 的 Meria 商业区引入 MYDIN、Maplewood 国际学校和 San Francisco Coffee。
notable: 以8604万令吉收购吉隆坡三块相邻永久地契发展地，买卖协议已于2026年9月2日无条件生效。
推出 Accent Petaling Jaya 项目，为首个 Accent 系列项目，首推取得60%认购率。
为 Cybersouth 的 Meria 商业区引入 MYDIN、Maplewood 国际学校和 San Francisco Coffee。

news.title: Avaland Berhad Reports Earnings Results for the Third Quarter and Nine Months Ended September 30, 2026
Avaland Posts Quarterly Profit Attributable Of 29.93 Million RGT
Avaland 3Q net profit surges to RM29.9mil
Avaland posts highest quarterly net profit since 4Q2024
Avaland’s Accent Petaling Jaya records 60% take-up at launch
Avaland launches Accent Petaling Jaya, first project under new Accent series, with 60% take-up
Avaland brings in Mydin, Maplewood International School, San Francisco Coffee to Cybersouth’s Meria hub
Avaland adds MYDIN, school and café to Meria line-up

recent_en: Avaland announced on 18 November 2026 its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with net profit surging to RM29.93 million, the highest quarterly net profit since 4Q2024. The company recently acquired three adjoining freehold development land parcels in Kuala Lumpur for RM86.04 million and launched its new project Accent Petaling Jaya, achieving a 60% take-up rate at launch. It also brought in MYDIN, Maplewood International School and San Francisco Coffee to the Meria hub in Cybersouth.
notable_en: Acquired three adjoining freehold development land parcels in Kuala Lumpur for RM86.04 million; the SPA became unconditional on 2 September 2026.
Launched Accent Petaling Jaya, the first project under the new Accent series, achieving a 60% take-up rate at launch.
Brought in MYDIN, Maplewood International School and San Francisco Coffee to the Meria hub in Cybersouth.
